title: Schwalbe tire pressure FAQ
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. The permissible pressure range is indicated on the tire sidewall, and riders should under no circumstances exceed or fall below the minimum and maximum limits specified on the tire. The page gives rough guidance by rider type and a separate note on TLE/TLR tires on hookless rims; it does not prescribe a pressure for any particular bike.
